meta.name: setup
meta.description: Run initial NanoClaw setup. Use when user wants to install NanoClaw, configure it, or go through first-time setup. Triggers on "setup", "install", "configure nanoclaw", or first-time setup requests.

copy.tagline: 完成 NanoClaw 的首次安装与配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接触 NanoClaw 需要初始化设置
copy.tagline_en: Complete initial setup and configuration of NanoClaw
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are new to NanoClaw and need to initialize it

howto.what: 当你说出触发词时，Claude 会告诉你运行 `bash nanoclaw.sh` 脚本。该脚本自动完成 NanoClaw 的完整初始化，包括安装依赖、配置凭证和创建第一个代理。若中途出错，脚本会借助 Claude 协助恢复并从中断处继续。
howto.when: 当你提到“setup”、“install”或“configure nanoclaw”等关键词，或请求首次设置时触发。

say.note: Claude 会指示你运行安装脚本。
Claude 会引导你执行完整的初始化流程。

howto.what_en: When triggered, Claude instructs you to run the `bash nanoclaw.sh` script. The script sets up NanoClaw end-to-end: dependencies, container, vault, credentials, service, first agent, and optional channels. If an error occurs, it offers Claude-assisted recovery and resumes from the failure point.
howto.when_en: Triggers on keywords like "setup", "install", "configure nanoclaw", or first-time setup requests.

say_en.note: Claude will ask you to run the setup script.
Claude will walk you through the full initialization.
